Lookups: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_LOOKUP WHERE IS_ACTIVE ORDER BY LOOKUP_TYPE, DISPLAY_ORDER, NAME
Scenarios: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_SCENARIO ORDER BY SCENARIO_TYPE, FISCAL_YEAR DESC, SCENARIO_NAME
ScenarioPeriods: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_SCENARIO_PERIOD WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} ORDER BY PERIOD_KEY
Calendar: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_PERIOD WHERE YEAR = {P} ORDER BY PERIOD_KEY
Employees: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_EMPLOYEE WHERE IS_CURRENT_VERSION AND NOT IS_PLANNED ORDER BY FULL_NAME
EmployeeHistory: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_EMPLOYEE WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = {E} ORDER BY VALID_FROM_PERIOD_KEY
MonthlyInputs: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_PAYROLL_INPUT WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} AND PERIOD_KEY = {P} ORDER BY FULL_NAME
ScenarioInputs: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_PAYROLL_INPUT WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} ORDER BY FULL_NAME, PERIOD_KEY
Allocations: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_ALLOCATION WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} AND PERIOD_KEY = {P} ORDER BY EMPLOYEE_ID, ALLOCATION_TYPE, ALLOCATION_CODE
PayrollSummary: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_PAYROLL_SUMMARY WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} AND PERIOD_KEY = {P}
ScenarioPayroll: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_PAYROLL_SUMMARY WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} ORDER BY PERIOD_KEY, EMPLOYEE_ID
PayrollLines: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_PAYROLL_LINE WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} AND PERIOD_KEY = {P} ORDER BY EMPLOYEE_ID, DISPLAY_ORDER
ScenarioPayrollLines: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_PAYROLL_LINE WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} ORDER BY PERIOD_KEY, EMPLOYEE_ID, DISPLAY_ORDER
CostCenterSummary: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_COST_CENTER_SUMMARY WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} AND PERIOD_KEY = {P} ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, FUND_CODE
ScenarioSummary: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_SCENARIO_SUMMARY WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} ORDER BY PERIOD_KEY, ENTITY_CODE
DashboardKpi: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_DASHBOARD_KPI ORDER BY ENTITY_CODE
BudgetVsActual: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_BUDGET_VS_ACTUAL WHERE YEAR = {P} ORDER BY PERIOD_KEY, ENTITY_CODE
ApprovalProgress: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_F_APPROVAL_PROGRESS WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} AND PERIOD_KEY = {P} ORDER BY STEP_ORDER
ScenarioEmployees: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_SCENARIO_EMPLOYEE WHERE SCENARIO_ID = {S} ORDER BY FULL_NAME
ApprovalSteps: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_P_APPROVAL_STEP ORDER BY STEP_ORDER
Users: SELECT * FROM RPT.V_D_APP_USER ORDER BY DISPLAY_NAME
